notes.title: 🔥 HELLSEED: All Chapters – New Update with New Content and Improvements!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce a new update that will further enhance your gaming experience!

🆕 What’s new in this update:

Introduction of Chapter 0

 A short introductory chapter that starts at the beginning of the game, designed to immediately immerse you in the eerie and mysterious atmosphere of HELLSEED.
 This introduction adds narrative depth and sets the stage for the main story.

Improvements to Chapter 1

 We have streamlined certain sections of gameplay to make them more guided and fluid, reducing moments of waiting and backtracking.
 These changes preserve the oppressive feeling that defines the game while ensuring a less frustrating experience for players.


📌 Important recommendations:
As always, we recommend verifying the integrity of your game files via Steam if you encounter any issues or strange behavior during the game. This step can resolve potential errors caused by downloading the update.

🎉 Happy holidays to everyone!
With this update, we also want to take the opportunity to thank you for your continued support and wish you happy holidays. May you enjoy this festive season and start the new year with energy and happiness.

💀 Available now on Steam!
We look forward to hearing your thoughts on the new Chapter 0 and the improvements. Thank you again for being part of our community, and enjoy… if you dare. 👻

notes.title: Important Update: The Free Demo of HELLSEED Has Been Retired
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We want to thank everyone who has supported HELLSEED by trying out the free demo. Over the years, the game has evolved significantly, introducing new mechanics, improved visuals, additional languages, enhanced controller support, and a much more immersive experience.

However, the demo, created several years ago, no longer reflects the quality and features of the full game. Key elements like the possession system, improved interface, updated shaders, enhanced progression, and a carefully balanced difficulty curve are not present in the demo. These are crucial to delivering the tension, immersion, and satisfaction that define HELLSEED: All Chapters.

To ensure that every new player can fully appreciate the polished and carefully crafted experience we’ve worked so hard to deliver, we have decided to retire the free demo.

HELLSEED: All Chapters provides a deeply engaging psychological horror experience, with a refined progression system and surprises that evolve across multiple chapters.

We are also actively exploring new content ideas for the future, aiming to expand the HELLSEED experience and bring even more to our players. Stay tuned for updates as we continue to work on exciting possibilities!

Thank you for your understanding and continued support. If you haven’t already, we encourage you to explore the full game and uncover its secrets.

Sincerely,
The Profenix Studio Team

notes.title: IMPORTANT NOTICE BEFORE THE UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

Good news,
We are going to update HELLSEED in the next days.
As anticipated in the last announcement the game has been completely restructured and a big performance improvement of the engine has been made.
IMPORTANT: No new content has been included in this update, only improvements. Next chapters will be included in successive updates.

Bad news,
This will come to a cost: saved games will be completely lost.

We know how important are saved games for a player, 
so we propose a solution:
HELLSEED has been designed to have fixed checkpoints so it is easy for us to produce saved games and provide them to you if you need. 
So, please, if you want to recover saved games after the next update write us at: profenixstudio@gmail.com specifying the point in the game you have reached.

PROFENIX STUDIO

notes.title: HELLSEED UPDATE #10: 03-16-2023
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

Today we publish a special update.
We have discovered a way to make the movements of the player smoother. 

Before this update, as you noticed, the movements of the player had some kind of jitter even at high frame rates, this is why the game framerate seemed low even if this was not true.

This is caused by different frequency between physics and gameplay/graphics. 
We have solved this problem by using some kind of extrapolation to align physics and graphics framerates.

We have decided to publish this as soon as possible and postpone other things in the next updates, because we think this is an important improvement to the game experience in general.

Enjoy and stay tuned!
PROFENIX STUDIO

notes.title: HELLSEED UPDATE #5: 12-30-2022 AMD RADEON FIX
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

Today we have released a new update for celebrating the end of the year!

AMD RADEON DRIVERS FIX
In the last months AMD has done a big job for optimizing OpenGL drivers, I confirm that S2Engine and so HELLSEED take advantage from that. The problem was that transparent surfaces and water did not render correctly. I've finally fixed these glitches.
These problems permain on the HELLSEED demo and current S2Engine public version. They will be updated next year as soon as possible.

FASTER LOADING
I've started to optimizing the loading speed. It seems that loading times have been significantly reduced in this version. Let me know :)

NEW CROUCH
Following some users feedback I've improved the crouch system. Now the crouch is "parallel" to other movements so Player doesn't stuck while performing crouch animation. This time the crouch also works when player runs.

TEXTUAL HELPS OPTION
I've added a new option into the menu general section. This new option enables some text that appears after some time the player doesn't understand what to do, this text gives player suggestions to help him. They can be enable and disable independently by the standard Helps (that are showed generally as blood strips indicating the way to follow).

AA OPTION
I've also inserted an anti-aliasing option into the rendering section of the menu. In previous version anti-aliasing were enabled/disabled only changing the graphics presets.

GENERAL CLEANING
I continued the general cleaning of the overal game by disabling drawers, lights and other interactive elements that aren't useful to the player (for example empty drawers) and generate only confusion. 
Of course the work isn't completely finished because the number of objects to replace is big. 
I think this work should also contribute to the general optimization of perfomances (less interactive objects to update)

DEBUG
As usual I've done additional small bug fixes that should generally improve the game experience.


Hoping you are enjoying the game, 
have a happy new year.

Good 2023 to all.

See you next year!
PROFENIX STUDIO

notes.title: NEW DEMO UPDATE (DEVLOG #2)
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

First, 
Thanks to all for appreciating our work. 
We are very happy our game has really scared a lot of you :D, we are confident the final release will be even more frightening.  

To celebrate the Autumn Steam Game Festival we have released a new demo with some important changes we made based on suggestions and feedback from gamers.

The following are latest improvements we made in addition to those showed in the DEVLOG #1 

NEW PHYSICS
Finally we have changed completely the physx version our engine implements.
Many users have found problems in playing the game beacuse the old physx library required installation that on some system failed the first time. This forced them to do some additional work for making the game to be installed correctly and played.
All these problems have been fixed with the new physx implementation.

IMPROVED INVENTORY VISUAL AND AUDIO
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348584/6edf0d0a57215e29b703ead07f581f88d6cc33d0.png
We have replaced the old, stylized inventory item icons with rendered images that make easier to recognize them.
We have also replaced the old irritating inventory sounds with more pleasant ones.

IMPROVED WOODEN BOARDS [SPOILER!!] 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348584/e422db235e6c8f3825522bfeae8a29b824b44235.png
[ATTENTION SPOILER!!] We have added ghost wooden boards on the cellar door appearing after escaping from the monster. In this way you view precisely where put them.

NEW SOUNDS
We have replaced the irritating breathing sound of the player with a more pleasant one.
We have added some new environmental sounds such as clock hands and neons.
We have also added some new sound playing when using items such as keys, screwdrivers, ladder, etc..
We have added a new sound when examining the documents.

NEW LAUNCH SYSTEM
Some users have experienced problems in starting the game because of the launching system.
The old system required to execute the configuration application before starting the demo. On some systems the configuration application simply doesn't start and the game application, if not properly configured, starts with a strange and unuseful resolution.
We have fixed this procedure by making the game application to automatically recognize the desktop resolution, in this way users that cannot reach to configure the game using configuration application are able to start the game with the correct resolution in any case. 

MONSTER INTRODUCTION NEW CUTSCENE [SPOILER!!!!!]
[ATTENTION SPOILER!!] We have improved the cutscene when monster comes out from the metallic door. It is much more comfortable when the control returns to the player.

SCREEN SPACE GI
We have improved the previous Screen Space Global Illumination shader, even if the feature is still in experimental phase.
Now the look is much more effective, with less artifacts and higher realism.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348584/4348a490f5e1946205e4ca0e3bd120546f962b84.png

MINOR BUGFIXES
Some other bugfixes have been made.

WARNING
Updating the demo all the saved game data will be invalidated.

Enjoy and stay tuned!
PROFENIX
